en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at Bin Mihran who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man who sleeps alone in a house, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> dislke that, and if he is desperate to that, so there is no problem, but he should frequent in the mentioning of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> during his sleep for as long as he can’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah ibn Mehran who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who sleeps in a house alone. He (the Imam) said, ‘I dislike it but if it is an emergency, then it is not harmful, however, he must speak of Allah a great deal and as much as he can, when he goes to sleep.’”
